Author: WowLookThatGuy
Name: Retainer Gear Optimizer
Description:
Cycles through every retainer at a summoning bell and distributes gear from your main inventory (Inventory 1-4) across all combat (DoW/DoM) retainers to maximize their total item level. Gear a retainer drops when it's upgraded can be passed down to another retainer in the same run, and no retainer ever loses item level in any slot. The armoury chest is ignored and gathering retainers are skipped for now.

Open a summoning bell, then use /rgo start or the Start button in /rgo. Enable Dry run in /rgo to preview the plan without moving anything.
Punchline: Distribute the gear in your inventory across all your combat retainers for the highest total item level.
